labels.present: source/runtime path was observed in a repository, not headset-verified
labels.authored: implementation or loader exists, separately staged content/device evidence outstanding
labels.queued: assigned to project; not imported for this usage
labels.conditional: style/license or technical suitability must be checked before use

rights.purchased_psx_mega_pack: Owner-confirmed commercial game-use rights at pack level; do not distribute the untouched paid source archive as a substitute asset library. Expanded folder preview version 2.9 is not proven identical to v3.2.1 ZIP.
rights.classic_64_and_retro_tree: CC0 per owner; maintain original provenance/notice.
rights.unrelated_archives: AS-012 through AS-018 have separate source and license identities; inspect supplied license/readme before shipping.
rights.derivatives: Only selected game-use meshes/textures or baked sprites in each game's own signed content/release pack; source originals remain in Drive.

assignments.role: Visible beach/fortification dressing and ally turret ammunition; verify actually drawn during daytime/nighttime and owned-turret scenes.
assignments.acceptance: Native source readback verified on main: breakwater_module.cpp loads the three BWM1 assets at session initialization and emits their actual converted triangles during Combat, with an added ammo-box instance beside a purchased support turret. Remaining: APK asset readback, correct stereo visibility/lighting/placement and Galaxy S9 frame budget. Do not claim device rendering yet.

assignments.role: Coastal hills, rear-facing treeline, terrain silhouettes and LOD across campaign backgrounds.
assignments.acceptance: Select specific GLBs, document original member paths, batch LODs/cull, test day-night lighting, full 360 movement-independent view and S9 frame budget.

assignments.role: Bunker perimeter and beach approach barricades; period-appropriate selection only.
assignments.acceptance: Confirm converted asset and original archive license/mesh mapping; generate bounded GLES2-compatible mesh; confirm placement, collision and occlusion.

assignments.role: Real bar/stockroom/living fixtures, interaction and lighting, not replacements for 24 original Unreal SKU models.
assignments.acceptance: Native source readback verified: reverie_native_asset_scope.h already accepts native/red-ledger/beckenburg/*.rlprop and native_asset_scope_test.cpp exercises its scoping restrictions. Remaining: supply exact private converted model bytes through authorized signed game-content packaging, confirm HostReadAsset readback, RLBP decode, 14-model/25-placement live scene rendering, interaction and device acceptance. Do not regress source scoping or replace original 24 Unreal SKU models.

assignments.role: Outdoor delivery alley, waiting zone and district street scenery.
assignments.acceptance: Verify original kit license and converted source correspondence; apply palette/scale and pedestrian clearances, GLES2 draw + culling; no entire pack upload.

assignments.role: Delivery/service-van exterior only if period, scale and silhouette match the Red Ledger district.
assignments.acceptance: Inspect mesh, UV, conversion rights/provenance and scene relevance; do not substitute for authored shop models or gameplay transport.

assignments.source: Shared 64x64 materials and six PSX/Retro Tree-derived overhead PNGs
assignments.role: Terrain sectors, crates, barrels, trees, supply objectives and tactical overhead icons already mapped in renderer/catalog.
assignments.acceptance: Preserve existing source SHA-256, faction clarity, tactical tile order and actual load sites; verify Galaxy S9 fullscreen/UI readability.

assignments.role: Baked overhead road variants for existing tactical terrain; retain native 2D renderer.
assignments.acceptance: Compare against already authored road.png/terrain catalog; import only visibly distinct orthographic tiles; no 3D model render in tactical mode.

assignments.role: Small reproducible licensed asset-loading stress scene for independent module APK/content-pack acceptance.
assignments.acceptance: Converted GLES2 subset, geometry counters, stereo depth, both eyes, interactive toggle/door, static-size hash, signed content install/update/uninstall and rollback test.

assignments.role: Low-poly airfield perimeter or aerial photo terrain only if the game's historical analogue and photo composition are retained.
assignments.acceptance: Source-version/license audit of urban kit, photo-distance LOD and purposeful in-world recon effect; avoid modern electronics, cars and generic combat aircraft.

assignments.role: Optional station and hangar structural mesh bases only, with new candy-themed materials; no generic military craft substitution.
assignments.acceptance: Preserve candy-world identity and high-contrast UI; use selected source GLBs only after visual fit/renderer acceptance.

assignments.role: Optional native GLES2 game-specific retro filter, never the default hub control/UI readability mode.
assignments.acceptance: Do not copy Godot/Unity shader text into native GLES2 unchanged; license audit, parameterized comfort and no HUD degradation.

assignments.role: Existing acquired chess artwork must not be replaced by blocky low-poly placeholders.
assignments.acceptance: No substitution. Finish using the game's actual intended chess assets.

assignments.role: Emulators need accurate original rendering and controls, not substitute world meshes.
